facts.text: "Number 5 has read every recipe in the library. This one tastes better than the book said. More, please."
facts.why: Johnny 5 never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Johnny 5, so it reads as a film line. His real lines are things like 'No disassemble!' and 'Need input!'.

facts.text: the lab canteen before the escape
facts.why: No canteen scene in the transcript. The film shows a Nova Robotics demo presentation, with Dr Marner's gin and tonic, before Number 5 leaves the debriefing station.
facts.fix: the Nova Robotics demo day, before Number 5 walks out

vibe.verdict: The chalkboard truck has Number 5's no disassemble line, Laser Lips and the lightning footer, but the chalkboard layout drops every dish note so most of the jokes never print.
